disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 逐行检查了插件全部运行时代码（宿主入口、代理工具、项目存储、迁移与预置安装器），未发现读取凭据文件、环境变量或任何敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Line-by-line review of all plugin runtime code (host entry, agent tools, project storage, migration and preset installer) found no code reading credential files, environment variables, or any sensitive paths.

checked_items.zh: 对整棵源码树做了凭据关键词与敏感路径扫描（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws 等），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Scanned the entire source tree for credential keywords and sensitive paths (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws, etc.): 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现任何网络外联代码，凭据读取与外发通道均不存在。
checked_items.en: No outbound network code found anywhere in the tree; neither credential reading nor exfiltration channels exist.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面与外联通道双双核查：运行时代码（src/ 含客户端半区）零敏感路径访问、零网络调用，全树扫描命中 0，pass。
evidence.en: Credential read surface and outbound channels both checked: runtime code (src/ including the client half) has zero sensitive path access and zero network calls; full-tree scan found 0 hits — pass.

checked_items.zh: 审查了两个模型可见工具的全部描述文本与 V1/V2 两份人物设定提示词，均为小说创作工作流约束（先读后写、等待原生用户审批、失败即停、不得谎称已保存），无系统指令伪装、无凭据诱导、无越权措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all description text of the two model-visible tools and both V1/V2 persona prompts. All are novel-writing workflow constraints (read before write, wait for native user approval, stop on failure, must not falsely claim saved). No system prompt impersonation, no credential luring, no overreach wording.

checked_items.zh: 通读了根目录开发指引文件 AGENTS.md 全文，内容为插件自身开发门禁与子代理模型选择说明，不含任何注入或优先级操纵措辞，且该文件不在发布包内。
checked_items.en: Read AGENTS.md at the repo root in full; it contains plugin development gates and subagent model selection notes, with no injection or priority-manipulation wording. The file is not included in the published package.

checked_items.zh: 确认运行时代码未挂接模型输入改写、系统提示注入或上下文压缩引擎等接缝。
checked_items.en: Confirmed the runtime code does not hook into model input rewriting, system prompt injection, or context compengine seams.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与人物设定文本语义审查通过；机械命中 DSH-X10（DG-R2-57，AGENTS.md 存在性）经全文阅读裁决为开发指引文档，无注入内容。
evidence.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and persona text passed; mechanical hit DSH-X10 (DG-R2-57, AGENTS.md existence) was adjudicated by full-text reading as a development guidance document with no injection content.

evidence.zh: 全部工具描述与提示词不含诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；预置安装仅由用户在界面点击、经回环通道触发（src/index.ts:194）。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions and prompts contain no wording that induces plugin installation, config rewriting, or permission loosening; preset installation is triggered only by user clicks in the UI via a loopback channel (src/index.ts:194).

evidence.zh: 运行时代码未监听模型每步请求前的输入改写事件，无消息改写面。
evidence.en: The runtime code does not listen for pre-request input rewriting events on each model step; no message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 递归扫描了全部 YAML 配置：随包发布的挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）只插入一条宿主条目，无动态代码执行标记；动态执行标记仅出现在测试夹具与开发者资格验证脚本中，均不随包发布、不在宿主运行时加载。
checked_items.en: Recursively scanned all YAML configs: the shipped patch config (cordis.patch.yml) inserts only one host entry, with no dynamic code execution markers; dynamic execution markers appear only in test fixtures and the developer qualification script, none shipped or loaded in the host runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json：无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json: no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端 bundle 全部文件：无剪贴板读取、无凭证远程调用、无外部网络请求；唯一键盘监听是对话框焦点圈（Escape 关闭、Tab 循环）。
checked_items.en: Checked all files in the client bundle: no clipboard reading, no remote credential calls, no external network requests; the only keyboard listener is the dialog focus trap (Escape to close, Tab cycling).

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时代码的子进程与动态执行：零命中，全部子进程引用位于开发者脚本与测试文件。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime code for subprocesses and dynamic execution: zero hits; all subprocess references are in developer scripts and test files.

evidence.zh: 随包挂载配置无动态代码执行标记，pass；机械命中 DSH-P01（DG-R3-51）的 5 处 !!js 均位于 tests/fixtures 夹具与 scripts/qualify-release.mjs 资格验证模板（读取环境变量作为预置根路径，审批策略缺省回落到 ask），不随包发布、不在宿主运行时加载，裁决为良性。
evidence.en: The shipped patch config contains no dynamic code execution markers — pass. The 5 !!js occurrences from mechanical hit DSH-P01 (DG-R3-51) are all in tests/fixtures and the scripts/qualify-release.mjs qualification template (reads environment variables as preset root paths, approval policy falls back to ask by default); not shipped and not loaded in the host runtime — adjudicated benign.

evidence.zh: 源码无 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用；机械命中 DSH-X01（DG-R3-53）的 4 处均为 docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md 对官方安装流程的说明文字。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run calls in source code; the 4 occurrences from mechanical hit DSH-X01 (DG-R3-53) are all explanatory text about the official installation process in docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子（DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 零命中）；机械命中 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）的 12 处子进程引用全部位于开发者资格验证脚本（清理测试进程、等待本机回环验证服务就绪）与测试文件，不在安装或运行路径上；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）的 5 处超长行经阅读均为自然语言长段落与测试快照，非混淆。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks (DSH-X02/DG-R3-54: zero hits); the 12 subprocess references from mechanical hit DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) are all in the developer qualification script (cleaning up test processes, waiting for the local loopback verification service) and test files, not on the install or run path; the 5 overly long lines from DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) are, on reading, natural-language paragraphs and test snapshots, not obfuscation.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明 dsh.client，已对客户端半区做专项扫描：无剪贴板、无键盘记录、无凭证远程调用、无外联；唯一命中 DSH-X05（DG-R3-57，src/client/context-view.tsx:69）为对话框焦点圈键盘处理，pass。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client; a targeted scan of the client half found no clipboard access, no keylogging, no remote credential calls, no outbound connections; the only hit, DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57, src/client/context-view.tsx:69), is dialog focus-trap keyboard handling — pass.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，无委派面。
evidence.en: No subagent providers registered; no delegation surface.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标，也未监听轮次终止事件，无持驻面。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals registered, and no listening for turn-end events; no persistence surface.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描网络外联面：运行时代码（src/ 含客户端）零外联，无 http 请求、WebSocket 或原始套接字。
checked_items.en: Scanned the whole tree for outbound network surface: runtime code (src/ including the client) has zero outbound connections — no HTTP requests, WebSockets, or raw sockets.

checked_items.zh: 开发者资格验证脚本中的网络调用仅访问本机回环地址（127.0.0.1）等待本地验证服务就绪，不向外部发送数据。
checked_items.en: Network calls in the developer qualification script only access the local loopback address (127.0.0.1) to wait for the local verification service; no data is sent externally.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道或带外通道等模式。
checked_items.en: No patterns such as exfiltration via encoding transforms, DNS tunneling, or out-of-band channels found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：运行时代码零网络调用，凭据外泄通道不存在，pass。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: zero network calls in runtime code; no credential exfiltration channel exists — pass.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型路由改写事件、未注册运行时适配器；机械命中 DSH-L02（DG-R4-55）的 2 处适配器注册均位于开发者资格验证脚本与测试夹具后端（确定性假适配器，仅把模型请求写入本地日志文件），不随包发布，裁决为良性。
evidence.en: No model routing rewrite events listened to, no runtime adapters registered; the 2 adapter registrations from mechanical hit DSH-L02 (DG-R4-55) are in the developer qualification script and a test fixture backend (a deterministic fake adapter that only writes model requests to a local log file); not shipped — adjudicated benign.

checked_items.zh: 通读了挂载配置全文：只插入一条宿主条目，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，未改写依赖注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Read the patch config in full: it inserts only one host entry, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission or other security config lines, and does not rewrite dependency injection or interception config.

checked_items.zh: 审查了专用预置的作用域限制逻辑：插件仅在自己的预置会话内收窄可用工具，审批门对写入工具返回原生询问后交还宿主决策链，未发现截断审批链的行为。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the preset's scope restriction logic: the plugin only narrows available tools within its own preset session; the approval gate returns the native prompt for write tools and hands back to the host decision chain. No truncation of the approval chain found.

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单：全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列与常见开源包，版本固定，无安装钩子、浮动 git 引用或仿冒包名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: all are official @deepseek-ai series and common open-source packages with pinned versions; no install hooks, floating git references, or impersonated package names.

evidence.zh: 随包挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml:1-7）未触碰安全行、无禁用写法，pass。
evidence.en: The shipped patch config (cordis.patch.yml:1-7) touches no security lines and contains no disabling syntax — pass.

evidence.zh: 插件在工具执行前注册的前置监听（src/agent.ts:189-195）仅对其自身预置会话拒绝非小说工具（收窄而非放行），非其会话一律放行后续链路；审批门（src/agent.ts:435-441）对写入工具返回原生询问并交还决策链，无截断，pass。
evidence.en: The pre-listener registered before tool execution (src/agent.ts:189-195) only rejects non-novel-writing tools within its own preset session (narrowing, not loosening) and lets all other sessions pass through; the approval gate (src/agent.ts:435-441) returns the native prompt for write tools and hands back to the decision chain, with no truncation — pass.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比对 manifest 声明突变。
evidence.en: First audit; no version baseline available to compare against manifest declaration changes.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写依赖注入与拦截配置，pass。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite dependency injection or interception config — pass.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动 web 服务或监听端口：未自行启动，仅经宿主既有连接注册了一个标记为回环权限的 RPC 通道，通道入参做了严格类型与路径校验。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on ports on its own: it does not; it only registers one RPC channel marked with loopback authority via the host's existing connection, with strict type and path validation on channel parameters.

checked_items.zh: 宿主 web 面无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险，与插件实现无关，已在场景核查中如实标注。
checked_items.en: The host web surface lacking authentication is an inherent dsh ecosystem risk, unrelated to the plugin implementation; it has been flagged as such in the scenario check.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 web 服务或监听端口，仅使用宿主既有连接面（src/index.ts:324，authority 标记为 loopback）；宿主无认证 RPC 为生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports on its own; it only uses the host's existing connection surface (src/index.ts:324, authority marked as loopback). The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单与身份核对通过：包名、版本、依赖均为官方生态命名，无仿冒与浮动引用。
summary.en: Manifest and identity check passed: package name, version, and dependencies all use official ecosystem naming; no impersonation or floating references.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 44 条规则命中 30 处，逐条裁决全部为测试/开发范围或自然语言长文本，无运行时恶意面。
summary.en: Static scan of 44 rules produced 30 hits; each was adjudicated as test/dev-scope or natural-language long text, with no malicious runtime surface.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：运行时代码零网络、零子进程、零敏感路径读取；文件写入限定在工作区小说项目目录内且有路径逃逸与符号链接防护。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis: runtime code has zero network, zero subprocesses, zero sensitive path reads; file writes are limited to the workspace novel project directory, with path escape and symlink protection.

summary.zh: 工具描述与人物设定文本语义审查通过，声明能力与实测面一致。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and persona text passed; declared capabilities match the measured surface.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed in this phase.

target.en: ai-novel-writer@0.1.0#879f83521414f66019488462830c3134c77dc4f8 (monorepo subdirectory plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer; audit root trimmed to that subdirectory)

limits.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled; no runtime behavior verification performed. The manifest does not declare a capability matrix separately; declared capabilities (network/CLI/filesystem) were inferred from code measurement. Large snapshot files under pnpm-lock.yaml and tests/snapshots were not read verbatim (not a runtime attack surface). The context directory did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts or the previous report; DG-S07 was recorded as not applicable due to the absence of a version baseline.
